# Northern Italy Journey · Local Dishes Import Template (Starters / Mains / Desserts / Snacks)

※ This file is a plain-text sample for the Food Planner - Local Specialties view.
※ In the Local Specialties view, choose Import Document to auto-fill; supports .txt / .md / .docx.
※ Format notes:
※   Section header: ## Local Specialties
※   Day line: Day + number + colon + date + colon + city theme.
※   Dish line: bracketed course tag [Starter] / [Main] / [Dessert] / [Snack] + space + dish name.
※   Following lines become description.

## Local Specialties

Day 1: Sep 17: Milan
[Starter] Prosciutto e Melone (Parma Ham with Melon)
Description: Savory cured Parma ham wrapped around sweet melon, a classic balance of salty and sweet.
[Main] Risotto alla Milanese (Milanese Saffron Risotto)
Description: Golden saffron risotto slow-cooked with beef marrow broth and finished with shaved Parmigiano.
[Dessert] Tiramisù
Description: Venetian layered dessert of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream, melting on the tongue.

Day 3: Sep 19: Rome
[Starter] Supplì al Telefono (Roman Fried Rice Balls)
Description: Crispy fried rice croquettes filled with mozzarella that stretches like telephone cords when hot.
[Main] Spaghetti alla Carbonara
Description: Rome's iconic pasta dish with guanciale, Pecorino Romano, and fresh egg yolks without cream.
[Main] Abbacchio alla Scottadito (Grilled Lamb Chops)
Description: Traditional Roman grilled lamb chops with rosemary and lemon, named "Scottadito" (burn your fingers).
[Snack] Pizza al Taglio (Roman Square Pizza by the Slice)
Description: Light, airy Roman-style sheet pizza sold by weight, perfect for eating on the go.
[Dessert] Roman Ricotta Cake
Description: Baked fresh ricotta cheese tart scented with candied lemon peel.
